WITH client_by_region AS (
  SELECT 
    d.A3 as region,
    COUNT(*) as region_count
  FROM disp
  JOIN account a ON disp.account_id = a.account_id
  JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id
  GROUP BY d.A3
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(region_count) as total FROM client_by_region
),
region_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    region,
    region_count,
    CAST(region_count AS FLOAT) / (SELECT total FROM total_count) as share
  FROM client_by_region
),
avg_share AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share FROM region_shares
),
filtered_regions AS (
  SELECT rs.* FROM region_shares rs CROSS JOIN avg_share a
  WHERE rs.share > a.avg_share
)
SELECT 
  SUM(region_count) as total_count,
  AVG(share) as avg_share,
  AVG(share - (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share)) as avg_distance_above
FROM filtered_regions
